decisions.title: Sunken Red
decisions.author: Jeroen Brouwers
decisions.finding: Foundation identifies original Bezonken rood (1981) and describes the novel. Exact selected English edition is already production-bound by the separate cover task. This change adds a separate original English summary and leaves that edition and cover intact.
decisions.identityConflict: Dutch original already exists as Work 1066. Do not add a duplicate Dutch edition to 1647 or consolidate user data in this code patch.

limitations: Restoring a useful synopsis does not prove Google will index a page.

No noindex, canonical, hreflang, route or score rules changed.
Production Work 1647 first_publish_year=1988 is the translation year; original 1981 is explained in visible summary. A catalog correction remains separate.
